# Mountable

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/mount.h`](../../../src/logic/player/mount.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

An animal that can be ridden: where the rider sits, its trunk box, the speeds a rider asks.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `saddle` | `glm::vec3` | top of the back where the rider sits, Transform frame, model units |
| `joint` | `int` | joint of its AnimalPose that carries the saddle; -1: the Transform |
| `joint_local` | `glm::vec3` | the saddle in that joint's frame |
| `centre` | `glm::vec3` | centre of the trunk box, Transform frame |
| `half_extent` | `glm::vec3` | half size of the trunk box |
| `walk_speed` | `float` | m/s a rider asks (1.5), in the animal's own units |
| `run_speed` | `float` | m/s with the run button (5) |
| `rider` | `entt::entity` | written: the player riding it |
| `collider` | `entt::entity` | written: the entity of its kinematic body while a rider is around |

## Notes

Added by Mountables (or by hand: tests). Destroying it destroys its collider entity (Mountables' signal). saddleOf() gives the saddle in world space.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: MountSteering, RiderSeat. Written by: Mountables, Mounting. Created by: Mountables. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MountSteering](../systems/MountSteering.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | walk_speed, run_speed |
| [Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create** | tick; signal on_destroy<Mountable> | emplaced from the species' shape; `rider` read, `collider` written; a destroyed Mountable destroys its collider entity |
| [Mounting](../systems/Mounting.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | preinit (storage), tick, touched, mount, dismount | `rider` set and cleared; collider read; saddle via saddleOf |
| [RiderSeat](../systems/RiderSeat.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (and helper saddleOf) | the saddle |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[MountSteering](../systems/MountSteering.md)**
  - None.
- **[Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<Mountable>` in preinit (disconnected in finish).
  - Reads the species' skin geometry (`resources/animals/species/<id>.bin`) once per species, runs `analyseGait` on its walk clip.
  - Creates a collider entity per Mountable within `range` of a Rider (or ridden) and destroys it when none is.
  - Logs once per species: `Mountables : <id>, saddle <h> m up on <joint>, walks <v> m/s, runs <v> m/s` (info), or a warning when the geometry cannot be read.
- **[Mounting](../systems/Mounting.md)**
  - `CollideShape` of the player's capsule, at its place and 0.6 m lower, with max separation `reach`, on a press of jump when not riding.
  - Sets the collision group of the ridden animal's collider; clears it 0.6 s after getting off.
  - On a jump off: `SetLinearVelocity` of the player (the saddle's velocity plus `hop` m/s to the animal's left and 1 m/s up).
- **[RiderSeat](../systems/RiderSeat.md)**
  - At each physics step: `AddForce` on the rider's body ((pull - gravity) x mass) and `ActivateBody`.
